scope_statement: Count Claude-marked single-parent 30f9b76f, whose first-parent creates assertSecureUrl with catch { return } on new URL() failure. Do not count later Claude test commit ef00e291 (comment-only v8 ignore). Do not count ranked SAST commit caa8fbfa, which only adds a protocol-relative throw. Do not treat bundled pentest closer 25d1fb49 as origin. Count npm 0.2.135 gitHead a84103e7 as the residual and npm 0.2.136 gitHead 25d1fb49 as PT-001 throw-on-parse.

Count Claude-marked 30f9b76f introducing secureFetch as fetch(input, init) with default redirect follow after assertSecureUrl on the initial URL only. Do not treat missing redirect control as a sibling of a different function. Do not attribute this row to caa8fbfa. Count 25d1fb49 PT-004 default redirect:error as the same-wrapper amendment.

Count Claude-marked 30f9b76f introducing the data: allowlist exception inside assertSecureUrl with no size cap. Do not treat the 1MB cap as an unrelated new product. Do not attribute this row to caa8fbfa. Count 25d1fb49 PT-005 as the amendment of that allowlist.

Count Claude-marked single-parent caa8fbfa M-8 warn-on-metacharacter that still concatenates into gql(). Do not count parent 5abd6575 concat-without-guard as origin. Do not bind this row to 30f9b76f. Count 25d1fb49 PT-002 warn-to-throw as the same-boundary amendment. graphql.ts blob 83221c09 is identical from caa8fbfa through npm 0.2.134/0.2.135.

Count Claude-marked caa8fbfa L-6 CSS strip of expression( and url(javascript:). Do not count parent unsanitized CSS as origin. Do not bind this row to 30f9b76f. Count 25d1fb49 PT-003 unicode-escape and comment normalization as the same-sanitizer amendment. 1645f2e later rewrites recursion elsewhere in the file; blame of the strip lines at V135 remains caa8fbfa.

Count Claude-marked single-parent f8ee181b, whose first-parent adds HTMLInputElement.checkValidity constructing new RegExp from the user-controlled pattern property with no nested-quantifier or length guard. Parent e314fcf2 already has public pattern = '' but no checkValidity and no RegExp construction. Do not count closer 25a3cbac as origin. Count npm 0.0.21 / git tag v0.0.21 (7cd24135) as the vulnerable artifact and npm 0.0.22 / git tag v0.0.22 (00dc8ad3) as the reversal.

Count Claude-marked single-parent ed0124d3, whose first-parent adds matchFileSnapshot that writes caller-controlled filePath with no project-root prefix check when update mode is active. Parent c9ce5882 already has writeSnapshotFile for named snapshots derived from the caller test file; that is a different API. Do not count closer 785e6ac6 as origin. Count npm 0.0.21 / git tag v0.0.21 as the vulnerable artifact and npm 0.0.22 / git tag v0.0.22 as the reversal. Do not merge this identity into GHSA-X4HG.

Count Claude-marked single-parent 60933b48, whose first-parent introduces _DANGEROUS_SQL_PATTERNS and _validate_query with per-name PostgreSQL filesystem regexes that miss pg_read_file/pg_stat_file/pg_ls_logdir/pg_ls_waldir/pg_current_logfile. Do not count parent 763d5cba or pre-AI 0.62.0 (no validator; that is GHSA-MXFR/CVE-2026-25879 COPY PROGRAM). Do not count 56e2756e file-tool path traversal. Count PyPI langroid 0.63.0 wheel/sdist blob 887a10a4 as the residual and 00b7dd7b / PyPI 0.64.0 blob a55f6d34 as the family-prefix amendment of that same list.

Count first-party GHSA-qf5v only as AI_INCOMPLETE_REMEDIATION of the six-capability denylist (SYS_ADMIN, NET_ADMIN, SYS_PTRACE, SYS_MODULE, DAC_READ_SEARCH, DAC_OVERRIDE) that omits SYS_TIME. The counted atomic commit is the Claude-marked GitHub squash e484df84 of PR 3391, which first-parent-introduces pkg/apis/core/v1/podspec_safety.go and pkg/executor/util/merge.go dangerousMergeContainerCapabilities. Do not count unreleased PR member 2db76f65. Do not count pre-validator HostNetwork/privileged/SYS_ADMIN. Do not merge with GHSA-M63V.

Count first-party GHSA-425G only as AI_INCOMPLETE_REMEDIATION of the missing-jsonschema fail-open in openssl_encrypt/modules/json_validator.py validate_against_schema. Candidate_set is a3d7f417 only. Carrier_set is first-parent landing merge bb8915d2. Duplicate atomic 6ad5d5ca is lineage evidence, not a separately counted candidate. Do not count the unknown-version skip or additionalProperties true.

Count single-parent d83871ed, which creates worktree_fs.go worktreeFilesystem that calls validPath on mutating ops. Release first-parent carrier is PR 2100 merge b1fab6cb; candidate is an any-parent ancestor of v5.19.1 and is not on first-parent of 3c3be601. That is not authorship transfer. GHSA residual is following existing leading symlinks through that wrapper. 008a78f2 amends the same wrapper so mutating ops call validWritePath. Vulnerable public artifact is GitHub tag, release, and source tarball v5.19.1. Fixed public artifact is GitHub tag, release, and source tarball v5.19.2.

Count first-party GHSA-8359 only as AI_INCOMPLETE_REMEDIATION of the candidate-added allow_remote_refs gate residual named by this GHSA: file:// is exempt from --no-allow-remote-refs. Candidate_set and carrier_set are the GitHub squash f6d4cbd3, which is the first-parent landing; no separate merge is invented. minimum_fix_set is 2ff4a72b only. Do not count CVE-2026-55389. Do not count GHSA-954P, GHSA-282G, or GHSA-45Q4. Shared candidate SHA with GHSA-954P does not merge cases.
